title: Drinking Tea May Reduce Vascular Disease Risk - Nautilus
gist: A study of nearly half a million adults in the China Kadoorie Biobank over about nine years examined whether tea drinking, including cups, temperature, type and strength, relates to vascular disease. The article's excerpt does not state the results or the catch.

insights.claim: Tea contains compounds with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity and may benefit gut microbiomes.

insights.so_what: Backdrop for tea and functional-beverage health claims.
